subject: Webinar (1/27/26): Getting Course Materials Ready for WCAG 2.1 AA in 2026
snippet:
Learn how lecture notes, lab manuals, and PDFs can be converted into accessible digital formats.
 
 WCAG 2.1 AA is a set of accessibility standards that ensure digital course materials can be used by students with disabilities, including those who rely on screen readers, keyboard-only navigation, or
